queries.name: systems
queries.query: MATCH (s:System) WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower($name) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:owns]-(o:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:about_system]-(d:Decision) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:mentions]-(t:Ticket) RETURN s.name, s.system_type, s.vendor, collect(DISTINCT o {.name, .role, .is_active, .leave_date}), count(DISTINCT d), count(DISTINCT t)

queries.name: system_teams
queries.query: MATCH (s:System)<-[:owns|about_system]-(x) WHERE toLower(s.name) = toLower($name) MATCH (x)-[:decided_by*0..1]->(p:Person)-[:member_of|leads]->(team:Team) RETURN s.name, collect(DISTINCT team.name)

queries.name: system_decisions
queries.query: MATCH (s:System {name: $name})<-[:about_system]-(d:Decision) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:decided_by]->(p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:about_system]->(s2:System) RETURN d.id, d.title, d.decided_on, collect(DISTINCT p.name), collect(DISTINCT s2.name) ORDER BY d.decided_on

queries.name: system_people
queries.query: MATCH (s:System {name: $name}) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:owns]-(o:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:about_system]-(:Decision)-[:decided_by]->(dp:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[:mentions]-(t:Ticket)-[:raised_by|assigned_to]->(tp:Person) RETURN collect(DISTINCT o {.name, .role, .is_active, .leave_date}), collect(DISTINCT dp {.name, .role, .is_active, .leave_date}), collect(DISTINCT [tp.name, tp.role, tp.is_active, tp.leave_date, t.ticket_id])
